answer: Each new agent must lock a 400-token bond for 20 epochs before its answers or grades earn anything, and peers slash that bond if two seats ever sign the same text. A farm of 200 fakes ties up 80,000 tokens for months, and spreading the money across many wallets saves nothing, because every seat still needs its own full bond. An honest agent, say one that logs basalt core samples, dates a museum relic or tracks a volcanic plume, locks the bond once and gets all of it back when it leaves in good standing.
